title: [Feature Request]: Readers integration with MarkItDown and Embeddings integration with Chonkie AutoEmbeddings
body:
### Feature Description

The feature would include:
- A new reader that would use MarkItDown as a file parser and extractor
- A new embedding module, which uses [Chonkie AutoEmbeddings](https://docs.chonkie.ai/embeddings/auto-embeddings) as a comfortable unified interface to load several different embedding models (from different providers, such as Sentence Transformers, OpenAI, Jina...) within only one class
**I already worked on these two integrations and I would be able to open a PR with them**, just let me know if these integrations could be of any use or if you prefer them not to be included :))

### Reason

I have been working with Chonkie and with MarkItDown extensively in recent times and, since they are already integrated or I am planning to integrate them with LlamaIndex in the very next future, it would be nice to have these two integrations.

### Value of Feature

_No response_

- `chonkie[all]`
- `markitdown[all] == 0.1.0`

Fixes #18576

- [ ] Yes
- [X] No[^1]

- [X] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)

## How Has This Been Tested?

Your pull-request will likely not be merged unless it is covered by some form of impactful unit testing.

## Suggested Checklist:

- [ ] I have commented my code, particularly in hard-to-understand areas[^3]

- [ ] I have added Google Colab support for the newly added notebooks.

- [X] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works

[^1]: I did use `llama-index-core` with more liberal versioning settings in `pyproject.toml`, tho: see [here](https://github.com/AstraBert/llama_index/blob/29ecc1f248e11117acfe7e38d3e4f2945f1a52f4/llama-index-integrations/embeddings/llama-index-embeddings-autoembeddings/pyproject.toml#L35) for an example
